title: Career Roadmap — Media Planner
summary: A Media Planner determines where, when, and how advertising campaigns should reach their target audiences. The role combines audience research, media selection, budget allocation, campaign scheduling and performance analysis across digital and traditional channels.

about.label: Career domain
about.text: Advertising, Media Strategy, Digital Marketing & Analytics

blocks.text: A Media Planner determines where, when, and how advertising campaigns should reach their target audiences. The role combines audience research, media selection, budget allocation, campaign scheduling and performance analysis across digital and traditional channels.

items.text: Researching target audiences and media consumption habits.
Selecting channels such as social media, search, television, radio, print and outdoor advertising.
Planning advertising budgets, reach, frequency and campaign schedules.
Coordinating with media buyers, creative teams and clients.
Analysing campaign results and recommending improvements.

rows.text: Advertising fundamentals, communication, consumer behaviour, basic statistics and Excel
Create a target-audience profile and competitor media analysis
Media research, media economics, campaign planning, digital advertising and budgeting
Develop a media plan for a fictional brand
Paid media, audience segmentation, reach/frequency, campaign analytics and internships
Build a multichannel campaign plan with a performance dashboard
Media strategy, optimisation, client presentations and placement preparation
Complete a professional media-planning portfolio and internship

blocks.text: For a three-year bachelor's programme, compress the milestones and prioritise an internship and portfolio before graduation.

blocks.label: ROAS
blocks.text: Revenue attributed to advertising divided by advertising spend.

blocks.label: Reach and frequency
blocks.text: The number of people exposed and the average exposure per person.
Complete these five projects to demonstrate practical readiness.

items.text: Media plan for a product launch: Define the audience, objectives, channel mix, budget and schedule.

blocks.label: Digital campaign budget allocation
blocks.text: Compare Google Ads and Meta Ads using a hypothetical budget.

blocks.label: Audience research report
blocks.text: Analyse audience demographics, interests and media habits.

blocks.label: Campaign performance dashboard
blocks.text: Track impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA and ROAS using sample data.

blocks.label: Media optimisation case study
blocks.text: Explain how you would reallocate a campaign budget based on performance.
Label hypothetical budgets and results clearly. Do not present simulated campaign performance as actual client results.

blocks.label: Primary recommendation
blocks.text: Focus on audience research, Excel-based budget planning, advertising metrics and digital campaign analysis. A portfolio that demonstrates how you allocate budgets and justify channel choices will help distinguish you from candidates with only theoretical knowledge.
